The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) mentioned many times that protecting trust is a duty that every Muslim must undertake. The name 'Amail' bears this Islamic value by representing one who is trustworthy and reliable.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Amail' is that it reflects the trust and reliance we place in Allah (swt), the Creator of the universe.
